entities.summary: Wellington, a notable figure in the history of Spain, associated with Peninsular War & Loss of Empire (1808–1814). Preceded by Cortes of Cádiz producing the 1812 Constitution and Dos de Mayo uprising in Madrid against Napoleon. Their legacy influenced Cortes of Cádiz promulgate liberal constitution and First Republic.
